verdict.rationale: Docs clearly document container tags as hard isolation boundaries per user/agent/app, with explicit statements that tag-scoped searches never return cross-tenant memories and code examples showing containerTag usage for scoping and deletion. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of isolation guarantees beyond vendor docs, and no detail on cross-tenant leakage testing or edge cases (e.g., shared profiles/buckets interacting with tags).
